messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — routing_evaluator: detected inter-region route oscillation affecting eu-west-1 -> primary backends. spike: 5xx and latency variance. paging oncall team. monitoring: https://mon.redwood.local/alerts/2135550000 :rotating_light:

maria: ack, oncall here. seeing elevated 502/504 from recent user tests. starting live chase.

alex: I'm paged and moving to this thread. quick note: traffic appears to flip between eu-west-1 and us-east-1 every ~25–40s, correlated with spikes. reproducing with a small load test.

tanner: I can reproduce locally with a simple curl loop — when the route flips we see timeouts. sample: 
```
for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.test/eu/ping; sleep 1; done
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
...
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
...
```

maria: looking at policy-evaluator logs. there's churn at the decision boundary: two candidate regions score almost equal and tie-breaker alternates. grabbing recent evals.

alex: can you paste the policy snippet? maybe the recent weight bump on latency_bucket is the cause.

maria: snippet from policy (sanitized):
```
match: region_pref
weights:
  latency_bucket: 0.55
  capacity_headroom: 0.40
  proximity: 0.05
tie_breaker: round_robin
```
Note: latency_bucket was bumped in last deploy ~2h ago.

sre-bot: runbook triggered: "Routing oscillation mitigation". Recommended immediate mitigations: 1) apply short duration bias to prefer eu-west-1 (10–15m), 2) increase evaluator hysteresis to 30s, 3) notify customers.

alex: propose we apply a temporary override rather than edit policy (faster rollback). CLI command I intend to run: 
```
rwctl route override --selector region=eu --target eu-west-1 --duration 900 --reason "mitigate evaluator churn"
```

maria: approve. please run and post response. @tanner keep smoke tests running.

alex: running now...
```
> rwctl: override applied id=ovr-5582 target=eu-west-1 duration=900
> audit: user=alex action=override id=ovr-5582
```

tanner: after override, error rate dropped immediately in eu traces. 5xx went from 3.6% -> 0.6% over 90s. latency p95 improved ~320ms -> ~120ms. attaching quick graphs: https://mon.redwood.local/d/route-osc-2135550000

ryan: any known customer impact? CS reports 2 customers in EU reported increased latencies and timeouts for ~8–10m. no major data loss, but degraded UX. I've opened two support tickets (INC-8712, INC-8713).

maria: rough impact estimate: ~1.8% of sessions in eu experienced at least one timeout; top-ten affected tenants are internal test tenants and a couple of small EU customers.

alex: while override is mitigating, root cause looks config-related: the latency_bucket weight update pushed many edge evals to the tie region. I recommend rolling the weight back to previous value (commit abc123) and adding hysteresis.

maria: agreed. planning rollback of the policy weights via platform deploy (non-override) after we confirm stability for 5m. I'll coordinate with platform-team.

platform-team: acknowledged. staging rollback in 2m, will promote to prod if metrics stay green.

sre-bot: autopromote policy rollback scheduled: job=promote-rollback id=prom-21355501 status=running

system-deploy-bot: policy revert succeeded. commit reverted to abc123. change-id=chg-abc123-revert.

alex: metrics are stable post-revert. evaluator churn stopped, no further flips observed for 10m.

tanner: running extended smoke for 30m; will report if anything resurfaces. initial 15m look good.

maria: handing off to platform-team for follow-up actions (postmortem, add hysteresis to policy, extend unit/e2e test to include near-boundary scenarios). Oncall: I'll hand to night shift at 2135570000.

platform-team: noted. action items created: PLAT-422 (add evaluator hysteresis + test), PLAT-423 (improve canary for weight changes), OPS-110 (document override procedure).

ryan: sent customer notes to affected tenants; using template with incident summary and mitigation steps.

alex: marking incident as mitigated. severity set to Sev2 (partial customer impact, quick mitigation, root cause config). will draft postmortem with timeline. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks team — great quick ops. closing thread after handoff.
